newsitem.title: USA: Potomac shuts 2 Md. power units for repairs.
newsitem.headline: Potomac shuts 2 Md. power units for repairs.

text.p: Potomac Electric Power Co (PEPCO) said Monday two of the four generating units at its Chalk Point power plant in Aquasco, Md., were shut this weekend for repairs.
Chalk Point's 341 megawatt (MW) unit 1 was idled to correct a boiler tube leak, and 672 MW unit 3 was taken out of service to repair condenser water box door leak, the utility confirmed.
The company did not yet set dates when either unit would resume operation, Potomac spokeswoman Nancy Daniel said.
Chalk Point 3 could return to service later today, and Chalk Point 1 as early as Thursday, market sources said.
Potomac Electric is the operator and sole owner of the Chalk Point facility, which has a total installed capacity over 2,000 MW.
The units can burn coal, natural gas or fuel oil.
